blurb: RoundtableSpace is the X account for Mario Nawfal’s Roundtable, a leading crypto and macro-focused Twitter Spaces show hosted by Mario Nawfal. The account covers breaking crypto news, market analysis, memecoin trends, DeFi, and geopolitical events, often drawing hundreds of thousands of live listeners. With over 155,000 followers, it is one of the most prominent crypto discussion platforms on X.
credibility_note: The account is a degen/alpha-oriented crypto show; content is often speculative and promotional. No major corrections or controversies were found in the provided sources.
